claims.text: **OAuth Token**: The extension mints an OAuth token by reusing your existing Garmin single-sign-on session: it exchanges that session for a short-lived service ticket, then for an OAuth1 token, kept until it stops working, and an OAuth2 access token that expires and is renewed with the OAuth1 token. It stores both in `chrome.storage.local` so it can call Garmin's API on your behalf across service-worker restarts. To mint them it uses the consumer key and secret of Garmin's mobile app as published by the open-source garth project, not a key Garmin issued to Kaiord.

claims.text: **Calendar Placement**: When you send workouts from the Kaiord App, the extension places each workout on its date in your Garmin Connect calendar (a calendar write). When a workout moves to another day, it adds the new calendar entry first and then deletes the old entry that Kaiord itself placed and has since superseded (a calendar delete). It deletes only entries that Kaiord's record holds as placed by Kaiord. An entry of that same workout that you added yourself is recognized, so no second one is added on its date, but it is never moved or deleted: when the workout moves on, Kaiord leaves it where it is and tells you once. It never deletes entries of other workouts, and never deletes library workouts.
